# LBCO on HRPT with aliases and constraints

The `pd-neut-cwl_lbco-hrpt_start-2` CLI project with the aliases and constraints of
diffraction-lib's analysis guide added to `analysis/analysis.edi`: four aliases and
`biso_Ba = biso_La`, `occ_Ba = 1 - occ_La`. Open this folder in the app to see the Analysis
page's Aliases and Constraints groups. The app does not bundle it.
